title: 第二十八章玄熊蛰息经
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张守安沉下心思，自己该怎么办呢？

慢慢升级，明显是不行了。

他对着刘全问道：“这里有上面传下的心法吗？”

心法，正如其言，沟通心脏，连接内外天地，讲究化周遭之灵力，入心脏之要，传入自身百穴，滋养自身。

众人通常以修炼称之，说的就是这个道理。

刘全正在拿着抹布，擦拭着地上的血迹，这种活现在不方便透露给外人，现在只能留给了他。

他思考了几秒，最后说道：“倒是有一本，是王猛前几年所得，现在在库里吃着灰。”

他停下手中的动作，看向张守安：“只不过，这个心法是二熊山那两只熊妖糊弄他的奖赏，这么多年来也没人敢修炼。”

“之前听王猛所说，这个心法可是极其强大，说是二熊山一脉相承的武学，修炼大成后，便可获得如熊一般的千钧之力。”

“但心法的重要性大人也是知道，若是有一丝的错误，可都是致命的。”

“之前王猛就是怕熊妖乱改功法，才没有修炼，所以我也不建议大人修炼那个功法。”

可张守安只是说道：“拿过来，我先看看。”

刘全见张守安根本不听自己的话，便叹了口气：“大人等我几分钟，我这就拿过来。”

几分钟后，刘全带着一本书册走了进来，他将书册递给张守安，同时还是警告了一遍：“大人，咱们的身体和妖物是不同的，这个功法可能妖物能修炼，人却是遭不住的。”

张守安接下，简单翻阅扫了一遍，最后合上，还给刘全。

“好，我知道了。”张守安淡然说道。

刘全接住书册，表情僵硬了一秒。

得，自己刚才这是白担心了，亏得自己之前害怕大人修炼这个功法伤到自己。

结果人就简单扫了一眼，估计连一个字都没

反倒是自己之前白费口舌了。

张守安转身就要离去，走了几步突然说道：

“对了，我要闭关修炼几日，这几天都不要打扰我。”

刘全收回书册，俯身道：“是。”

张守安走进卧房，盘腿坐在床榻之上，呼出一口气，眼前自动出现信息。

【收录功法成功】

Zhang Shou'an pondered, what should he do?

After slowly upgrading, it obviously doesn't work anymore.

He asked Liu Quan: "Is there any spiritual method passed down from above?"

The Heart Method, as it says, communicates with the heart, connects the internal and external world, and pays attention to transforming the spiritual power of the surroundings into the core of the heart, passing it into one's own acupuncture points, and nourishing oneself.

People usually call it cultivation, and this is what they mean.

Liu Quan was holding a rag and wiping the blood on the ground. This kind of work was not convenient to disclose to outsiders now, so it could only be left to him.

He thought for a few seconds and finally said: "There is a copy that Wang Meng obtained a few years ago and is now gathering dust in the library."

He stopped what he was doing and looked at Zhang Shou'an: "It's just that this mental method was a reward for the two bear demons in Erxiong Mountain who fooled him. No one has dared to practice it for so many years."

"I heard Wang Meng say before that this mental method is extremely powerful. It is said that it is a martial art inherited from the Erxiong Mountain. After mastering it, you can gain the power of a bear."

"But I also know the importance of mental skills. If there is even the slightest mistake, it will be fatal."

"Wang Meng didn't practice before because he was afraid that the bear demon would change the technique randomly, so I don't recommend that you practice that technique."

But Zhang Shou'an just said: "Bring it here, let me take a look first."

When Liu Quan saw that Zhang Shou'an didn't listen to him at all, he sighed: "Sir, wait for me for a few minutes. I will bring it over right now."

A few minutes later, Liu Quan came in with a book. He handed the book to Zhang Shouan and warned him: "Sir, our bodies are different from those of monsters. Monsters may be able to practice this technique, but humans cannot withstand it."

Zhang Shou'an took it, briefly browsed through it, and finally closed it and returned it to Liu Quan.

"Okay, I understand." Zhang Shou'an said calmly.

Liu Quan caught the book, his expression stiffened for a second.

Yes, I was worried in vain just now. Fortunately, I was afraid that adults would hurt me by practicing this technique.

As a result, the person just glanced at it briefly and probably didn’t even say a word.

On the contrary, I wasted my breath before.

Zhang Shou'an turned around and was about to leave. After walking a few steps, he suddenly said:

"By the way, I'm going to practice in seclusion for a few days. Don't disturb me these days."

Liu Quan took back the book, leaned over and said, "Yes."

Zhang Shou'an walked into the bedroom, sat cross-legged on the bed, exhaled, and a message automatically appeared in front of him.

[Successful collection of exercises]
